title: Acceptance formula evaluation
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $n,s$, and encoded configuration row $r$, the CNF formula consisting of the unit clauses requiring that the state is halted and the output summary is accepting evaluates to true under the Boolean encoding of $r$ if and only if $r$ is halted and its output summary is accepting.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$r$ is a row with the prescribed input, state, head, work-tape, and output-summary fields
